reviews.title: Stream Quality Fail for SB19 in Lollapalooza
reviews.text: There was just too much to be noted in the stream. The audio register was awful. The lag and even screen freeze were worse than disappointing. I feel bad for the boys who will be sad to hear the A’tin expressing a lot of dissatisfaction over this. And it’s not fair for the group being delivered to fans in such poor quality. A’tins deserve more than what we had. Not from the boys, but from how we expected to experience this with the boys. The level of talent and skill they put on that stage was superb as always but due to the technical issues that the viewers experienced watching from home. I hope a better version would be made available. Nevertheless, congratulations to the boys for eating that stage and taking Philippines to even higher heights.

reviews.title: Needs to be regulated more. Language translations should be free.
reviews.text: This app is kinda disappointing for several reasons. First off, There needs to be moderators on these livestreams because the majority of the chat is just full of spam comments, making it almost impossible for the artist to even read a question being asked, then on top of that, you’re only gonna get about 1 minute of free translation if the artist speaks a different language. After that you have to pay for some type of membership which I feel isn’t fair especially when there is no guarantee that your comment will even be seen. The comments need to be monitored because a lot of ppl come in there to slander artists or make inappropriate comments about their love lives or even sexuality. That’s not something I would like to be subjected to while trying to interact with a professional artist. I have reported several comments for this very reason. Maybe there also needs to be an age limit as well? Something needs to be done if you want ppl to pay money for memberships,etc because that is not a fair trade! The purpose of the app is to CONNECT with artists not for yall to MONETIZE.

reviews.title: BTS Busan concert pre-order merch location limitations
reviews.text: It is ridiculous that pre-order merch for the BTS Arirang concert in Busan is limited to a location within the pickup area. People who live farther away and were able to get tickets but can’t go earlier aren’t able to pre-order the merch we want and may leave with nothing if it sells out. There are multiple days of pre-order, and I’m sure one of these could have and should have been unrestricted on location. There are already limitations set to avoid multiple purchases and penalties for those who don’t show for their merch, so having the location range shouldn’t matter in this instance. I’m really upset with Weverse for this, and think they need to change this requirement for future shows.

reviews.title: Could use some work
reviews.text: The overall structure of the app is convenient since you are able access multiple features. However, the fact that it functions primarily has a live streaming platform yet the APP doesn’t function properly on tablets or computers seems counterintuitive. While you could use it on a browser like google or safari, there is a convenience feature of having it work as an app. You are able to download it on a table but it doesn’t work in landscape mode which is slightly disappointing. Further more have two different types of memberships seems like a cash grab. I have purchased the membership that allows me to get presale for concerts, but besides that the membership doesn’t do much else which is a shame. Then there is the monthly membership option that allows you to have a bit more features on the app. Logistically it seems more that these two being separate is a cash grab. When paying $20 for a membership you should be able to at least have some of the benefits that the monthly membership provides. For example the subtitles, this should honestly be available without any type of membership, but it not being included in the $20 membership is beyond absurd. Vlive you will still remain the best live streaming platform.

reviews.title: A mediocre fan platform
reviews.text:
It’s been ruined by tech bro management that only cares about adding new ways to monetize the platform rather than fixing bugs. I dread any time a new artist I like joins Weverse. The new features and bugs often make fan engagement frustrating. Notifications are broken. Often pressing on a notification opens a completely different post. This would be a little less annoying if pressing one notification didn’t clear all other notifications. Also, why pay for AI slop subtitles? If users are paying for it, they might as well hire actual human beings to make accurate subtitles that can be viewed later. Instead the AI subtitles forced Weverse to add a  stream delay to allow time to process subtitles that are often useless and inaccurate. I saw artists get confused and frustrated when this feature rolled out. They’re trying to engage with fans while livestreaming, but this just made things worse.
It feels like the developers don’t care about fan experiences. They clearly don’t even bother to use the app themselves given how long some of the bugs I’ve encountered still exist. I caution any company from having their artists use Weverse as their fan platform. I strongly hope they explore other options.
